summary_en: Daicel raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 from 70.00 yen to 75.00 yen per share, increasing the year-end payout from 35.00 yen to 40.00 yen. The revision targets DOE of 5.0% and total shareholder return of 65.7% including a concurrent share buyback.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Daicel Corporation revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased its full-year dividend per share from 70.00 yen (comprising 35.00 yen interim and 35.00 yen year-end) to 75.00 yen (35.00 yen interim and 40.00 yen year-end), a 5.00 yen increase in the year-end dividend.

The revision reflects the company's medium-term strategy "Accelerate 2030" beginning fiscal 2027, which targets stable and progressive dividend growth with DOE of 5.0% or higher and total return ratio of 60% or more. Based on the updated full-year earnings forecast announced on the same date, the year-end dividend was raised from the previously forecast 35.00 yen to 40.00 yen per share.

The company expects this revision will achieve DOE of 5.0% and total shareholder return of 65.7% when combined with concurrent share buyback activities announced on the same date.
